objections.title: BA's enumeration missed 2 dev-narrative warnings on Day 5 (timeline.json:664 and :665)
objections.description: BA's spec table W1-W16 enumerates 16 timeline.json warnings. Independent inspection of Day 5 warnings[] (lines 663-667) reveals THREE dev-narrative entries, not one: (a) line 663 'STRUCTURAL CHANGE' (BA's W1, captured); (b) line 664 'Previous split_day structure (Matilde solo Chengdu / Jade Beijing class) has been removed entirely.' (BA MISSED); (c) line 665 'OLD transportation.json entry (3U8900 Beijing→Chengdu for Matilde on May 6) is SUPERSEDED — both travelers arrived Chengdu on Day 4 evening via DR5010.' (BA MISSED). Both lines 664 and 665 describe past structural-rebuild decisions, reference removed-content, and use exactly the same dev-cycle vocabulary that motivated the user's 彻底清理 directive ('removed entirely', 'OLD transportation.json entry', 'is SUPERSEDED').
evidence: grep -niE 'superseded' data/china-20260412-092624/timeline.json returns 3 lines: 665 (uppercase SUPERSEDED), 1229, 1357. BA's case-sensitive AC2 regex catches only 1229 and 1357.

M5 in BA spec says 'Day 5 warnings[] (line 663): the single STRUCTURAL-CHANGE entry deleted. Remaining warnings (location anchor, walkability) preserved.' — but lines 664 and 665 are NOT 'location anchor / walkability' entries; they are dev-narrative.
objections.remediation_required: BA must (a) add lines 664 and 665 to evidence table as W1.5 and W1.6 (or renumber), (b) update M5 to explicitly delete those entries as well, (c) confirm only line 667 'Day 5: Location is Yulin West Road...' is the legitimate location-anchor entry to preserve.

objections.title: AC2 regex pattern `superseded` is case-sensitive and misses uppercase SUPERSEDED at timeline.json:665
objections.description: AC2 is stated as: `grep -E '本期|out of scope|superseded|STRUCTURAL CHANGE|OLD timeline' data/china-20260412-092624/timeline.json` returns no matches. The intent of the AC is to catch dev-cycle 'superseded' phrasing. Line 665 contains 'is SUPERSEDED' (uppercase) which BA's regex would NOT match. If dev applies M5-M13 verbatim (deleting only the lines BA explicitly enumerated), the AC2 grep will return 0 matches BUT line 665 will remain — passing the AC literal text while VIOLATING the user's 彻底清理 intent. This is exactly the spec-text-vs-execution drift pattern: AC literal text can be satisfied while user-need is not.
evidence: grep -niE 'superseded' data/china-20260412-092624/timeline.json -> 3 matches (665, 1229, 1357). The delta line 665 is true dev-narrative.
objections.remediation_required: Update AC2 regex to be case-insensitive: change `grep -E` to `grep -iE`, OR explicitly add `SUPERSEDED` as alternation, OR add 'OLD transportation' / 'has been removed entirely' / 'Previous split_day' alternations to the pattern. The literal AC text in the BA spec must change so the runnable command matches the AC's intent.

objections.title: BA's 彻底清理 scope did not enumerate dev-workflow phrases ('placeholder', 'TBD', 'to be planned during Day N review') that ALSO appear in user-rendered timeline keys
objections.description: The user said '彻底清理' (thorough cleanup) of dev-cycle internal narrative. BA scoped narrowly to phrases matching the seed pattern '本期|out of scope|superseded|STRUCTURAL CHANGE|OLD timeline|...'. However, dev-workflow language ALSO leaks via: (a) timeline.json warnings entries like line 666 'All specific activities, meals, and restaurants are PLACEHOLDERS — to be planned during Day 5 review.' and line 799 'all specific restaurant names are TBD — to be planned during Day 6 review.'; (b) user-rendered timeline KEY NAMES like '(to plan in Day 7 review)', '(to plan in Day 14 review)', '(to plan in Day 15 review)' at lines 807/813/818/824/1541/1547/1552/1558/1596/1602/1607/1618. These are NOT in BA's scope but they ARE dev-workflow phrases visible to the user. BA correctly identified W4 (line 851 'to be planned in Day 7 review' inside warning) and M12 partially addresses Day 14 'to plan in review', but the broader pattern is not enumerated. The user's 彻底清理 intent could plausibly include these.
evidence: grep -nE '(to plan|to be planned) in Day [0-9]+ review|placeholder|TBD' data/china-20260412-092624/timeline.json returns 17+ matches across lines 666, 799, 807, 813, 818, 824, 851, 1541, 1547, 1552, 1558, 1586, 1596, 1602, 1607, 1618, 1634

M12 in BA spec acknowledges 'to plan in Day 14 review' workflow phrase as dev-workflow but only addresses Day 14 (line 1586). Other days (Day 7, Day 15, plus the timeline-key occurrences) not addressed.
objections.remediation_required: Either (a) explicitly document the scoping boundary: 'this cycle covers only the 20 enumerated items; dev-workflow phrases like to plan in Day N review remain because they reflect legitimate plan-status of placeholder days, NOT dev-cycle terminology' — and add to Out-of-Scope Observations; OR (b) expand evidence to enumerate them and decide KEEP/DELETE per location. Option (a) is acceptable if the user's intent is narrowly the contradictory 'out of scope / 本期不渲染' narrative; option (b) is needed for true 彻底清理.

objections.title: BA stayed scoped to dev-cycle narrative leakage; did NOT over-expand into rendering/architecture

Read modification-log.json:1518/1689/1692 — all are historical entries describing prior cycles' decisions; the file's purpose IS to log such decisions; rewriting them would be revisionism.
